entries.toelichting: Verb of acting-foolishly / spurning (Deu 32:15; 2Sa 3:33; Pro 30:32; Mic 7:6; Nah 3:6). 5 occurrences. Hyphenated; the spurning-pole of nabal.
Homonym verb of fading/withering (Ex 18:18; 2Sa 22:46; Ps 1:3; 18:46 [45]; 37:2; Isa 1:30; 24:4; 28:1,4; 34:4; 40:7-8; 64:5 [6]; Jer 8:13). 20 occurrences. Standard.
Used (1Sa 1:24; 10:3; 25:18; 2Sa 16:1; Job 38:37; Jer 13:12; 48:12; Lam 4:2; Hos 3:2). 11 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Adjective; the foolish-spurner (Deu 32:6,21; 2Sa 3:33; 13:13; Job 2:10; 30:8; Ps 14:1; 39:9 [8]; 53:2 [1]; 74:18,22; Pro 17:7,21; 30:22; Isa 32:5,6; Jer 17:11; Eze 13:3). 17 occurrences. Standard.
Husband of Abigail (1Sa 25; 2Sa 2:2; 3:3). Means 'fool'. 22 occurrences. English convention.

Substantive of nabal-spurning; the disgraceful-act (Gen 34:7; Deu 22:21; Jos 7:15; Jdg 19:23,24; 20:6,10; 1Sa 25:25; 2Sa 13:12; Job 42:8; Isa 9:16 [17]; 32:6; Jer 29:23). 13 occurrences. Hyphenated to bridge moral-folly and outrage-act.
Verb of pouring-out / gushing-forth (Pro 1:23; 15:2,28; 18:4; Ps 19:3 [2]; 59:8 [7]; 78:2; 94:4; 119:171; 145:7). 11 occurrences. Hyphenated for the up-gushing aspect.
Hapax (Jos 15:62). Place in Judean wilderness. English convention.

Hi-stem of √nagad (be-conspicuous); 'cause-to-stand-out' = make-known / declare / report (Gen 3:11; 9:22; 12:18; 14:13; 21:26; 24:23,28,49; 26:32; 27:42; 29:12,15; 31:20-22,27; 32:6,30 [5,29]; 37:5,16; 38:13,24; 41:24-25; 42:29; 43:6,7; 44:24; 45:13,26; 46:31; 47:1; 48:2; 49:1; etc.). 369 occurrences. Hyphenated to bridge 'tell' (inform) and 'declare' (proclaim) — KJV uses 'tell/declare/show' contextually.

Preposition 'over-against / before / in-front-of' (Gen 2:18,20; 21:16; 25:21; 31:32,37; 33:12; etc.). 147 occurrences. Hyphenated. KJV 'before/over-against'; concordant uses hyphen for the spatial-positional kernel.
Verb of beaming-light (2Sa 22:29; Job 18:5; 22:28; Isa 9:1 [2]; 13:10; Ps 18:29 [28]). 6 occurrences. Standard.

Substantive of nagah; light-brightness (2Sa 22:13; Job 3:4; 22:28; Pro 4:18; Isa 4:5; 9:1 [2]; 50:10; 60:3,19; 62:1; Eze 1:4,13,27,28; 10:4; Hos 7:11 [actually H5060]; Am 5:20; Hab 3:4,11). 19 occurrences. Standard.
Son of David born in Jerusalem (1Chr 3:7; 14:6). English convention.
Verb of horn-thrusting (Ex 21:28-32; Deu 33:17; 1Ki 22:11; 2Chr 18:10; Eze 34:21; Dan 8:4; 11:40; Ps 44:6 [5]). 11 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Adjective of habitually-goring ox (Ex 21:29,36). 2 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Used (Job 30:9; Ps 4:1 [title]; 6:1 [title]; 54:1 [title]; 55:1 [title]; 61:1 [title]; 67:1 [title]; 76:1 [title]; Hab 3:19 [title]; Lam 3:14; 5:14; Isa 38:20). 14 occurrences. Hyphenated for the stringed-music compound.
Verb of playing-stringed-instruments (1Sa 16:16,17,18,23; 18:10; 19:9; 2Ki 3:15; Ps 33:3; 68:26 [25]; 2Chr 5:13; Isa 23:16; Eze 33:32). 15 occurrences. Hyphenated.

From √naga (touch-strike); divine-stroke / leprous-mark (Gen 12:17; Ex 11:1; Lev 13:2-59; 14:3-57; Num 19:18; Deu 17:8; 21:5; 24:8; 1Ki 8:37,38; 2Chr 6:28,29; Ps 38:12 [11]; 39:11 [10]; 89:33 [32]; 91:10; Pro 6:33; Isa 53:8). 78 occurrences. Hyphenated; KJV 'plague' (Lev 13-14) and 'stroke' elsewhere; the hyphen bridges both.
Verb of pouring-away / spilling (Job 20:28; 2Sa 14:14; Mic 1:4; Lam 3:49; Ps 77:3 [2]; 75:9 [8] (variant); Eze 35:5; Job 13:18 (variant); 28:11). 10 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (Ex 15:8; Jos 3:13,16; Ps 33:7; 78:13; Isa 17:11). 6 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Verb of free-will-giving (Ex 25:2; 35:21,29; Lev 7:16; Jdg 5:2,9; 1Chr 29:5,6,9,14,17; 2Chr 17:16; Ezr 1:6; 2:68; 3:5; Ps 110:3). 17 occurrences. Standard.
Aaron's eldest son (Ex 6:23; 24:1,9; 28:1; Lev 10:1; Num 3:2,4; 26:60,61; 1Chr 5:29; 6:3; 24:1,2). Also Jeroboam I's son (1Ki 14:20; 15:25-31). 19 occurrences. English convention.
Used twice (Ezr 6:4). Aramaic for stones-in-rows. Hyphenated.
Used twice (2Sa 14:14; 2Ki 17:21). Hyphenated for the rejecting-action.

Used (Lev 12:2,5; 15:19-33; 18:19; Num 6:11; 19:9-21; 31:23; 2Chr 29:5; Eze 7:19,20; 18:6; 22:10; 36:17; Ezr 9:11; Lam 1:8,17; Mic 5:2 [actually different]; Zec 13:1). 29 occurrences. Hyphenated technical-cultic-term; covers physical-menstruation (Lev 15) and figurative-impurity (Lev 20:21; Ezr 9:11).
Hapax (Dan 7:15). Aramaic; figurative for body-as-spirit-container. Hyphenated.
Verb of being-blown-away (Ex 15:10; Isa 41:2; Ps 1:4; 68:3 [2]; Job 32:13; 13:25; Ezr 9:14 (variant); Pro 21:6 (variant)). 9 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Verb of guiding-with-care (Gen 47:17; Ex 15:13; 2Chr 28:15; 32:22; Ps 23:2; 31:4 [3]; Isa 40:11; 49:10; 51:18). 10 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Levitical city in Zebulun (Jos 19:15; 21:35; Jdg 1:30). 3 occurrences. English convention.
Verb of low-roaring (Pro 5:11; 28:15; Eze 24:23; Jer 51:38; Isa 5:29-30). 5 occurrences. Standard.
Verb of streaming (Isa 2:2; 60:5; Mic 4:1; Jer 31:12; 51:44). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Variant; the streaming-of-nations to the mountain (Isa 2:2; Mic 4:1). 2 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Aramaic counterpart of nahar; Ezr/Dan. 15 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Verb of restraining / dissuading (Num 30:5,6,8,9,11,12; 32:7,9; Ps 33:10; 141:5). 9 occurrences. Standard.
Verb of bearing-fruit / uttering (Ps 62:11 [10]; 92:15 [14]; Pro 10:31; Zec 9:17). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated to bridge bear-fruit and pour-out-utterance.
Hapax (Isa 57:19). The fruit-of-lips, i.e. praise. Hyphenated.
Land east of Eden where Cain dwelt (Gen 4:16). Means 'wandering'. English convention.
Hapax (Ex 15:2). Hyphenated only contextually; here standard.
Hapax (1Chr 8:2). Son of Benjamin. English convention.
Prophetic-school location at Ramah (1Sa 19:18-23; 20:1). 12 occurrences. English convention.
Verb of dozing (Ps 76:6 [5]; 121:3,4; Isa 5:27; 56:10; Nah 3:18). 6 occurrences. Standard.

Verb of swaying / wandering / shaking (Ex 20:18 [21]; Num 32:13; Jdg 9:9,11,13; Pro 5:6 (variant); 1Sa 1:13; 2Sa 15:20; 2Ki 23:18 [variant]; Job 28:4 (variant); Lam 4:14,15; Ps 26:1 (variant); 36:11; 59:16 [15]; 109:10; Pro 5:6; Isa 6:4; 7:2; 19:1; 24:20; 29:9; Jer 4:1 (variant); 14:10; Lam 4:14,15; Am 4:8; 8:12; 9:9; Nah 3:12). 42 occurrences. Standard.
Levite (Ezr 8:33) and false-prophetess (Neh 6:14). 2 occurrences. English convention.
Verb in cultic-context; the lifting-and-waving of priestly portions before YH. 35 occurrences. Hyphenated technical-term.
Used twice (Song 6:11; 7:13 [12]; Ecc 12:5). Hyphenated only as needed; standard 'blossom'.
Hapax (Isa 52:15). The startling-of-peoples (variant reading of H5137a). Hyphenated.

The consecrated-one (Lev 25:5,11; Num 6:2-21; Jdg 13:5,7; 16:17; Lam 4:7; Am 2:11,12). 16 occurrences. English convention; the term is itself a transliteration of nazir but standardized in English as 'Nazirite'.
Verb of setting-apart (Lev 15:31; 22:2; Num 6:2-12; Eze 14:7; Hos 9:10; Zec 7:3). 5 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Variant; the dedication-as-Nazirite specifically (Num 6:2-12). 5 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Substantive; covers the diadem-of-priest (Ex 29:6; 39:30; Lev 8:9; 21:12), the royal-crown (2Sa 1:10; 2Ki 11:12; 2Chr 23:11; Ps 89:40 [39]; 132:18; Pro 27:24; Zec 9:16), and the long-hair-of-Nazirite (Num 6:7,9,12,18-21; Jer 7:29). 25 occurrences. Hyphenated to bridge crown and dedication-sign.
Patriarch of the flood (Gen 5:29-32; 6-9; 10:1,32; Isa 54:9; Eze 14:14,20; 1Chr 1:4). Also a daughter of Zelophehad (Num 26:33; 27:1; 36:11; Jos 17:3). 46 occurrences. English convention.
Hapax (Num 13:14). Spy from Naphtali. English convention.
Used (Job 15:11; 21:2; Isa 57:18; Hos 11:8; Zec 1:13). 3 occurrences. Standard.
Brother of Abraham (Gen 11:22-29; 22:20-23; 24:10,15,24,47; 29:5; 31:53; Jos 24:2; 1Chr 1:26). 18 occurrences. English convention.
Variant; the broader-valley sense (Eze 47:5,6,7,9,12 etc. variants). Hyphenated.
Patronymic of false-prophet Shemaiah (Jer 29:24,31,32). 3 occurrences. English convention.

Verb of changing-emotion: to comfort (Piel) and to relent / be-sorry (Niphal/Hithpael). 108 occurrences. The Piel-comfort sense (Isa 40:1; 49:13; 51:3; 52:9) and the Niphal-relent sense (Gen 6:6,7; Ex 32:12,14; Num 23:19; Deu 32:36; 1Sa 15:11,29,35; Jer 18:8,10; 26:3,13,19; Joe 2:13,14; Am 7:3,6; Jon 3:9,10; 4:2; Zec 8:14) share the kernel of deep-sigh-shift-of-mood. Concordant 'console-relent' (hyphenated) preserves both poles; KJV 'comfort/repent' splits them. Distinguished from H7725 shuv ('return-turn-back', the volitional repentance) and H5375 nasa (lift).
Used (Job 6:10; 15:11; 21:2; Ps 94:19; Isa 28:11 (variant); 66:11; Jer 16:7). 2 occurrences. Standard.
Cupbearer-governor (Neh 1:1; 3:16; 7:7; 8:9; 10:1; 12:26,47; Ezr 2:2). 8 occurrences. Means 'YH-comforts'. English convention.
Short-form pronoun 'we' (Ex 16:7,8; Num 32:32; 2Sa 17:12; Lam 3:42). 5 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Verb (Gen 30:27; 44:5,15; Lev 19:26; Deu 18:10; 1Ki 20:33; 2Ki 17:17; 21:6; 2Chr 33:6). 11 occurrences. Hyphenated technical-term; the 'hissing/whispering' enchantment-act, distinguished from H7080 qasam ('divine-by-lots') and H6049 anan ('soothsay-by-cloud').
Ammonite king (1Sa 11:1,2; 12:12; 2Sa 10:2; 17:25,27; 1Chr 19:1,2). 9 occurrences. Means 'serpent'. English convention.
Prince of Judah (Ex 6:23; Num 1:7; 2:3; 7:12,17; 10:14; Ru 4:20; 1Chr 2:10,11; Mat 1:4 (NT-context)). 10 occurrences. English convention.
Hapax (2Ki 24:8). Mother of Jehoiachin. English convention.
Hapax (2Ki 18:4). Hezekiah's name for Moses' bronze-serpent. Means 'thing-of-bronze'. English convention.
Verb of going-down / pressing-down (Job 17:16; 21:13; 36:16; Ps 38:3 [2]; 65:11 [10]; Pro 17:10; Jer 21:13; Joe 4:11 [3:11]; 1Sa 17:18 (variant); Job 33:24 (variant)). 11 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (Job 17:16; 36:16; Ps 38:3 [2]; Ecc 6:5; 4:6 (variant); Isa 30:15; 33:23 (variant); Pro 29:9 (variant); Job 36:7 (variant)). 7 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (Gen 21:15 (variant); Job 14:9; Ps 144:12; Isa 5:7; 17:10,11; Mic 1:6 (variant); Eze 31:4 (variant)). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Verb of dripping (Ex 15:8 (variant); Lev 14:7,16,27,51; Jdg 5:4; 1Sa 14:26; Job 29:22; 36:28; Ps 68:9 [8]; Pro 5:3; Song 4:11; 5:5,13; Isa 45:8; Joe 4:18 [3:18]; Am 7:16; 9:13; Mic 2:6,11; 4:1 (variant); Pro 24:24 (variant)). 18 occurrences. Standard.
Place near Bethlehem (Ezr 2:22; Neh 7:26). 2 occurrences. English convention.
Patronymic (2Sa 23:28,29; 2Ki 25:23; 1Chr 2:54; 9:16; 11:30; 27:13,15; Neh 12:28; Jer 40:8). 11 occurrences. English convention.
Verb of cherishing-anger (Lev 19:18; Jer 3:5,12; Nah 1:2; Ps 103:9; Pro 6:25 (variant); Song 1:6; 8:11,12). 9 occurrences. Hyphenated.

From √nuach (rest); the 'rest-aroma' of acceptable-sacrifice (Gen 8:21; Ex 29:18,25,41; Lev 1:9,13,17; 2:2,9,12; 3:5,16; 4:31; 6:8,14,21 [15,21,28]; 8:21,28; 17:6; 23:13,18; 26:31; Num 15:3,7,10,13,14,24; 18:17; 28:2,6,8,13,24,27; 29:2,6,8,13,36; Eze 6:13; 16:19; 20:28,41). 43 occurrences. Hyphenated technical-cultic-term; KJV 'sweet savour' (archaic), NIV 'pleasing aroma'. The Hebrew kernel is the rest-bringing odor (root nuach), which 'soothing' captures.
Used twice (Ezr 6:10; Dan 2:46). Aramaic counterpart. Hyphenated.
Capital of Assyria (Gen 10:11,12; 2Ki 19:36; Isa 37:37; Jon 1:2; 3:2-7; 4:11; Nah 1:1; 2:9 [8]; 3:7; Zep 2:13). 17 occurrences. English convention.
First-month name (Neh 2:1; Esth 3:7). 2 occurrences. English convention.
Used twice (Jer 4:3; Hos 10:12). Break-up new ground. Hyphenated.
Used (1Ki 11:36; 15:4; 2Ki 8:19; 2Chr 21:7; Pro 21:4 (variant)). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated; the lamp / dynasty-continuance.

Verb of striking / smiting / killing. 501 occurrences — major OT-frequency. Covers physical-blow (Ex 2:11), military-defeat (Jos 8:21), divine-judgment (Ex 7:25), priestly-cleansing (Lev 26:24), and ailment-affliction (Lev 26:21). Concordant 'strike' captures the kernel; KJV 'smite' (archaic), 'strike/kill' contextually. Distinguished from H2026 harag ('kill', specifically lethal), H4191 mut ('die-cause-die'), H7843 shachat ('destroy').
Egyptian Pharaoh (2Ki 23:29,33,35; 2Chr 35:20-22; 36:4 (variant); Jer 46:2). 3 occurrences. English convention.
Hapax (2Sa 6:6). The threshing-floor where Uzzah died. Hyphenated.
Used twice (Pro 14:23 (variant); Eze 1:9; 1:12 (variant); Pro 19:11 (variant)). 2 occurrences. Standard.
Used (2Sa 15:3; Pro 24:26; Isa 26:10; 30:10 (variant); 59:14; Am 3:10). 4 occurrences. Standard.
Verb (Gen 37:18; Num 25:18; Mal 1:14; Ps 105:25). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Variant; the active-disguise (1Ki 14:5,6; Pro 26:24; Isa 63:16 (variant); Jer 19:4 (variant)). 7 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Adjective; the unknown-other (Gen 31:15; Ex 2:22; 18:3; 21:8; Deu 14:21; 15:3; 17:15; 23:21 [20]; 29:21 [22]; Jdg 19:12; Ru 2:10; 2Sa 15:19; 1Ki 8:41,43; 2Chr 6:32,33; Neh 9:2; 13:30; Job 19:15; Ps 69:9 [8]; Pro 2:16; 5:20; 6:24; 7:5; 20:16; 23:27; 27:2,13; Ecc 6:2; Isa 2:6; 28:21; 60:10; 61:5; 62:8; Jer 2:21 (variant); 5:19; 8:19; Eze 44:7,9; Hos 5:7; 7:9; 8:12; Ob 1:11; Zep 1:8; Mal 2:11). 46 occurrences. Hyphenated to bridge foreign and stranger. Distinguished from H1616 ger (sojourner-resident-alien) and H8453 toshav (resident-temporary).
Verb of cutting-down (Job 8:12 (variant); 14:2 (variant); 18:16 (variant); 24:24; Ps 37:2 (variant); 90:6 (variant); Isa 33:12). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (Song 4:8; Isa 11:6; Jer 5:6; 13:23; Hos 13:7; Hab 1:8). 6 occurrences. Standard.
Used twice (Isa 15:6; Jer 48:34). Place in Moab. Hyphenated.
Grandfather of Jehu (1Ki 19:16; 2Ki 9:2,14,20; 2Chr 22:7). 5 occurrences. English convention.

From √nasas (lift-as-signal); the rallying-standard (Ex 17:15; Num 21:8,9; 26:10; Ps 60:6 [4]; Isa 5:26; 11:10,12; 13:2; 18:3; 30:17; 31:9; 33:23; 49:22; 62:10; Jer 4:6,21; 50:2; 51:12,27; Eze 27:7). 20 occurrences. Standard. Distinguished from H1714 degel (military-standard / divisional-flag).
Verb of removing landmark (Deu 19:14; 27:17; Pro 22:28; 23:10; Isa 59:14 (variant); Mic 6:14; Job 24:2; 2Ki 10:24 (variant); Hos 5:10; 2Sa 18:13 (variant)). 9 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (Deu 28:63; Pro 2:22; 15:25; Ps 52:7 [5]; Jer 22:24 (variant); 12:14 (variant)). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used twice (Eze 23:42 (variant); Hos 9:4 (variant); Ps 16:4 (variant); Isa 41:29 (variant)). 2 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (Jos 13:21; Eze 32:30; Ps 83:12 [11]; Mic 5:4 [5]; Dan 11:8 (variant)). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used twice (Ps 2:6; Pro 8:23). The royal-anointing/installation. Hyphenated.
